Class Vertices

java.lang.Object
icyllis.arc3d.sketch.Vertices
All Implemented Interfaces:
Bounded
public class Vertices extends Object implements Bounded
An immutable set of vertex data that can be used with Canvas.drawVertices(Vertices, Blender, Paint).
